title: Customer funds and payment clearing accounts to external statements and the GL
prompt: Reconcile opening balances and current activity in customer funds or payment clearing accounts to external statements and the GL.

setup.q: Which accounts are clearing or suspense accounts?
Which payment processors settle into the clearing accounts (and which account each one uses)?

inputs.name: Processor settlement report for the period

steps: pull the clearing account ledgers for the period and the prior month's closing balance; the opening balance must equal it
get the settlement report: the Stripe connection first, then Dime's stripe reconciliation, then a document request
run rollforward per clearing account: opening, charges and settlements in, payouts and fees out, closing; save to data/clearing-rollforward.json and the Detail sheet
run open_item_age to pair charges with payouts and age what is left open; list open items with their age and what would clear them
tie the closing balance to Dime's ledger and the processor's statement balance; every difference listed, none netted

done.text: The Detail sheet rolls forward per account: opening plus additions less reductions equals closing on every row and the totals row equals the column sums
The closing balance on the Tie-out equals each clearing account's ending balance in Dime's general ledger at the period end
Every exception row cites the processor transaction id or the ledger transaction id and the account
payment-clearing-reconciliation.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The opening balance agrees to the prior month's closing balance or the difference is its own exception; open items are aged individually, not as the net account balance
